# Alexandre Benkendorf

> Portfolio site for Alexandre Benkendorf, a Senior Frontend Engineer based in Albufeira, Portugal, working remotely. The site covers skills, professional experience and contact details.

## Sections

- [Skills & expertise](https://alexandrebenkendorf.com.br/#stack): Technical stack and areas of expertise, grouped by category.
- [Experience](https://alexandrebenkendorf.com.br/#experience): Professional history, from current role back through earlier positions.
